brief.topic: Why intentions matter in ordinary actions
brief.audience: Muslims who want a short, trustworthy daily reminder they can act on

coreInsight: The first hadith in Sahih al-Bukhari ties every deed to its intention, so an ordinary action can be done for Allah.

hooks.notes: Clear in two seconds; the teaching answers it.

selectionRationale: Most relevant and clearest at a glance; the teaching pays it off.

scenes.onScreen: Same action. Different intention. / Pause for one second.

scenes.purpose: Teaching: the source, verbatim, with its reference.
scenes.excerpt: The reward of deeds depends upon the intentions and every person will get the reward according to what he has intended

resolved.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الْأَنْصَارِيُّ ، قَالَ : أَخْبَرَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ التَّيْمِيُّ ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عَلْقَمَةَ بْنَ وَقَّاصٍ اللَّيْثِيَّ ، يَقُولُ : سَمِعْتُ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، يَقُولُ : " إِنَّمَا الْأَعْمَالُ بِالنِّيَّاتِ، وَإِنَّمَا لِكُلِّ امْرِئٍ مَا نَوَى، فَمَنْ كَانَتْ هِجْرَتُهُ إِلَى دُنْيَا يُصِيبُهَا أَوْ إِلَى امْرَأَةٍ يَنْكِحُهَا، فَهِجْرَتُهُ إِلَى مَا هَاجَرَ إِلَيْهِ
resolved.english: Narrated 'Umar bin Al-Khattab: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "The reward of deeds depends upon the intentions and every person will get the reward according to what he has intended. So whoever emigrated for worldly benefits or for a woman to marry, his emigration was for what he emigrated for

scenes.onScreen: Intend it before you do it. / Share it with a friend

caption.opening: The same action can begin with a different intention.
body: The very first hadith in Sahih al-Bukhari is about intention.
Before your next task today, pause and set it for Allah.

claims.text: Pausing to set an intention is our suggestion for acting on the hadith.
